systems.component: SECTOR_FATIGUE type without rule; dead scanner unlock
systems.currentBehavior: SECTOR_FATIGUE appears in normalizeLegacyModifier fallback without catalog rule. scanner-resource-visibility unlock never applied.
systems.targetResponsibility: Delete or implement; no silent no-ops.
systems.rationale: Obfuscates Aftermath simplification.
systems.shutdownOrMergePlan: Remove orphan type and dead unlock strings.
systems.migrationRequirement: Strip unknown aftermath types fail-closed with warning (future).

systems.component: ELITE_SUPPRESSION / eliteWeight reductions after successful clears
systems.currentBehavior: ELITE_SUPPRESSION and ANCHOR_PRESSURE_REDUCED lower eliteWeight. worldStateEngine only boosts eliteWeightDelta when eliteWeight>1 — reductions <1 do not lower spawn weights. Combined with elite-only boons, success can reduce build growth.
systems.targetResponsibility: Must not silently reduce principal source of run-build power (Core Loop §9); after boon sources diversify, suppression may remain pressure-only.
systems.rationale: Cross-system conflict: elite-only boons + elite suppression.
systems.shutdownOrMergePlan: Either wire reductions correctly as pressure-only, or remove suppression until Contacts exist; flag ELITE_SUPPRESSION_AFFECTS_SPAWNS.
systems.migrationRequirement: Review active ELITE_SUPPRESSION saves.
unresolvedQuestions: Is current non-application of eliteWeight<1 intentional soft-fail?

systems.component: Operation lifecycle AFTERMATH lock + completion effects
systems.currentBehavior: Dual 'aftermath' naming: sector modifiers vs lifecycle AFTERMATH locking community progress. Completion may grant rewardLevelBoost; unlockTemporarySectorModifier scanner-resource-visibility never applied; contractBiasDelta copied but not applied.
systems.targetResponsibility: One global featured Operation; one readable Aftermath; dead unlocks removed.
systems.rationale: Core Loop §4.2–4.3 simplify Operations and remove community progress complexity.
systems.shutdownOrMergePlan: Simplify to one featured op; remove dead unlocks; clarify naming.
systems.migrationRequirement: temporarySectorModifiers / sectorOperationLifecycle reshape.

systems.component: Stacking sector aftermath modifiers with intensity
systems.currentBehavior: 10 AFTERMATH_RULES; max 3 modifiers/sector; stackKey refresh/intensify; persists on WorldStatePersistedState.sectorAftermathModifiersBySector; applied via applyPostRunAftermath → next brief.
systems.targetResponsibility: One named Aftermath condition per sector, no stacking/intensity (Core Loop §4.2 / §9.2).
systems.rationale: Launch scope simplifies Aftermath.
systems.shutdownOrMergePlan: Replace multi-modifier merge with single named condition; migrate save map.
systems.migrationRequirement: Collapse sectorAftermathModifiersBySector to one active condition.

systems.component: Bound Requisition curated Ley-Scar grants (non-random)
systems.currentBehavior: BLOOD_PRICE / SUNKEN_RITE push curated leyLineMutations at run start. isLeyScarAcquisitionBlocked (IRONCLAD) can skip elite offers.
systems.targetResponsibility: Corrupted Bargain / Contract clause / Authority — not ordinary Requisition combat power.
systems.rationale: Core Loop moves sponsor mandates and combat engines off standard Requisitions.
systems.shutdownOrMergePlan: Rehome curated grants during Requisition merge.
systems.migrationRequirement: Map BR scar grants to new sources.

systems.component: Live random class-boon grant path (elite post-combat only)
systems.currentBehavior: isPostCombatBoonBlocked returns true unless node type ELITE_COMBAT (or ley-scar blocked). preparePostCombatMutations clears offers for non-elites. Boss victory skips boon; standard combat goes harvest. Elite post-combat is the ONLY live random class-boon source.
systems.targetResponsibility: Depth-scaled sources: First Omen, one Contact/depth, optional elites, bosses/Verdicts, Corrupted/Sponsor events — elites optional not sole reliable source.
systems.rationale: Core Loop §11.4–11.5 amends boon master; elite cannot remain only reliable source.
systems.shutdownOrMergePlan: Add Contact/Omen/boss sources behind flags; keep elite as optional premium.
systems.migrationRequirement: postCombatMutationChoices remains session; new pending-offer fields likely.
unresolvedQuestions: Authority Contact node type exists in procedural gen yet?

systems.component: Hard eligibility → composition → soft weighting → seeded selection
systems.currentBehavior: boonOffer/ pipeline prepares weighted offers from class catalogs; affinity soft-only; grafts update tags after apply.
systems.targetResponsibility: Remain authority for offer selection under new Authority-specific sources.
systems.rationale: Core Loop keeps universal compatibility/selection philosophy from boon master; amends cadence only.
systems.shutdownOrMergePlan: N/A — extend sources later.
systems.migrationRequirement: None for stack itself.

systems.component: VEIL_BLEED_BOON node kind unused in level pools
systems.currentBehavior: VEIL_BLEED_BOON type exists in descent matrix language and engage routing, but LEVEL_MATRIX pools never spawn it. Engage would open PostCombatBoonScreen which then auto-empties via elite gate.
systems.targetResponsibility: Revive as scheduled Contact/Bleed source or remove dead kind.
systems.rationale: Dead path; Core Loop wants scheduled Contacts — do not treat as live.
systems.shutdownOrMergePlan: Disable engage until spawned, or wire as Contact.
systems.migrationRequirement: None.

systems.component: Graft capacity and socket-quality gates by Class Rank
systems.currentBehavior: getGraftSocketAccessForClassRank returns capacity and allowFixedBasic/Ultimate/ApexMasterwork. Used by Sanctuary apply, offer filter, sanitization, ClassGraftUI, RestScreen, compatibility, recommendation requiredClassRank.
systems.targetResponsibility: Capacity independent of Class Rank (Core Loop: 1 socket intro, 2 by Depth 2 extraction).
systems.rationale: Core Loop §4.3 and §10.3 forbid Class Rank graft-capacity and socket-quality gates.
systems.shutdownOrMergePlan: Replace access fn with constant/full or depth-based capacity; update 3J tests; stop rank filtering offers.
systems.migrationRequirement: Existing mid-run grafts: sanitize under more permissive rules.
unresolvedQuestions: Exact capacity curve vs Core Loop depth targets?

systems.component: Stored reward hooks (abilities/grafts/boon pools) largely inert
systems.currentBehavior: Reward table writes unlockedAbilities/unlockedGraftLicenses/unlockedBoonPools/flags. Live graft access uses rank table, not license membership. unlockedBoonPools unused by classBoonEngine. CLASS_RANK_MIN unlock kind unused.
systems.targetResponsibility: Flavor/history flags only; never re-gate power.
systems.rationale: Dead wiring; clean later without blocking proof-of-fun.
systems.shutdownOrMergePlan: Stop applying hooks or leave as flavor-only.
systems.migrationRequirement: Optional prune of hook arrays.

systems.component: Class Rank XP, history, debrief presentation
systems.currentBehavior: Ranks 1–20; XP from debrief applyClassRankFromDebrief; event log; pinned goals; theater cards. Reward table comment says hooks-only for many rows, but capacity still uses live rank.
systems.targetResponsibility: Informational mastery record / non-power history (or deferred content). No run-entry combat power.
systems.rationale: Core Loop §4.2 converts Class Rank from power/socket track to non-power mastery or deferred.
systems.shutdownOrMergePlan: Keep XP/rank display; stop capacity from rank; optionally stop writing unused hooks.
systems.migrationRequirement: Preserve rank/xp fields.
unresolvedQuestions: Keep showing next-graft-license copy after gates removed?

systems.component: Persistent Veil Residue as graft power gate
systems.currentBehavior: sessionVeilResidueCollected / veilResidueBalance pays Sanctuary graft costs; vaulted across runs. Orthogonal to Class Rank XP but currently throttles graft application.
systems.targetResponsibility: No Residue cost for run-scoped Sanctuary Attune grafts.
systems.rationale: Core Loop §4.3 / §10.2: Attune consumes Sanctuary service, not persistent Residue.
systems.shutdownOrMergePlan: Feature-flag Residue graft costs off; retain Residue economy for other systems until audited.
systems.migrationRequirement: None for account balances; stop debiting on graft.
unresolvedQuestions: Other live Residue sinks that must remain?

systems.component: PlayerAccount + WorldState AsyncStorage persistence
systems.currentBehavior: player_account_v2 and world_state_v1 persist progression, weapons, keepsakes, residue, aftermath maps. ActiveIncursion and pendingDebrief are in-memory only.
systems.targetResponsibility: Retain account/world persistence; mid-run resume remains absent unless flagged later.
systems.rationale: Core infrastructure; Core Loop does not require mid-run save for proof-of-fun.
systems.shutdownOrMergePlan: N/A.
systems.migrationRequirement: See saveMigrationInventory for field-level work.

systems.component: Existing featureFlags module as host for future shutdown flags
systems.currentBehavior: src/data/featureFlags.ts currently exposes AMBUSH_ENCOUNTERS_ENABLED and RESONANCE_SYSTEM_ACTIVE only.
systems.targetResponsibility: Host Core Loop shutdown/migration flags without implementing them in Stage I.
systems.rationale: Core Loop §4.3: disabled systems should be feature-flagged before deletion when migration needed.
systems.shutdownOrMergePlan: Add candidate flags listed in featureFlagCandidates (audit only).
systems.migrationRequirement: None now.

systems.component: Expedition Relic (keepsake) catalog and preferred retained runtime
systems.currentBehavior: 20 KeepsakeId relics; equippedKeepsakeId + keepsakeDeployment; initializeKeepsakeRuntime; scanner/cargo/market/contract/safehouse/echo/extract hooks; debrief via runDebriefKeepsakeEngine. No direct combat stat bonuses by design.
systems.targetResponsibility: Technical base for merged Expedition Requisitions; donor catalog not 1:1 preserved.
systems.rationale: Core Loop §5 prefers adapting Expedition Relic runtime (deployment choices, hooks, counters, debrief).
systems.shutdownOrMergePlan: Retain runtime; absorb selected BR donors; retire dual-slot UI.
systems.migrationRequirement: Account equippedKeepsakeId + keepsakeDeployment remain; map BR crafteds into new IDs.

systems.component: Bound Requisition catalog, runtime, dual loadout slot
systems.currentBehavior: 19 Bound Requisition IDs; pre-run offers on BoundRequisitionScreen; runtime buildBoundRequisitionRuntime / applyBoundRequisitionAtRunStart; combat hooks (adrenaline, kinetic battery); market/ley-scar flags; account craftedAugments.
systems.targetResponsibility: Donor catalog into single Expedition Requisition (one equip). Recurring combat engines leave Requisition surface.
systems.rationale: Core Loop §5.1 merges BR + Relics; BR effects that are combat engines/mandates migrate conceptually.
systems.shutdownOrMergePlan: Migrate selected BR effects onto keepsake-style runtime; remove separate BR loadout slot; explicit ID migration table.
systems.migrationRequirement: Bound Requisition IDs require explicit save/run-state migration table (Core Loop §5).
unresolvedQuestions: Final merged roster size and which BR combat engines move to Authorities?

systems.component: Separate Bound Requisition and Expedition Relic loadout slots
systems.currentBehavior: Player can equip both a Bound Requisition and an Expedition Relic for the same run (separate screens/state).
systems.targetResponsibility: Exactly one Expedition Requisition before deployment.
systems.rationale: Core Loop §4.3 removes separate BR and Relic loadout slots.
systems.shutdownOrMergePlan: Collapse to one equip UI after donor merge.
systems.migrationRequirement: Choose surviving equipped ID when both present.

systems.component: ATTUNE heal + GRAFT mutate flow, Residue costs
systems.currentBehavior: RestScreen binary SanctuaryChoice ATTUNE|GRAFT. applySanctuaryAttune heals 30% max SA. Graft rolls 3 offers, rank-filters, charges sessionVeilResidueCollected. No MEND. Equipped-action filtering via canGraftClassAbility / Aegis surface.
systems.targetResponsibility: Mend=substantial heal; Attune=choose one of three grafts without Residue; grafts run-scoped.
systems.rationale: Core Loop §10.1–10.2 locked Mend/Attune flow; §4.3 removes persistent Residue costs for run-scoped grafts.
systems.shutdownOrMergePlan: Split ATTUNE heal→Mend; redefine Attune as graft choice; remove Residue charge for Sanctuary grafts; retarget SURVIVALIST/cargo heal hooks to Mend.
systems.migrationRequirement: Clear abilityGrafts on extract/death/abandon (already run-scoped); stop charging Residue.
unresolvedQuestions: Does Veil Residue remain for non-graft uses after Sanctuary decoupling?

systems.component: Narrative forceNextSanctuary write without consumer
systems.currentBehavior: narrativeEncounterMatrix can set forceNextSanctuary on IncursionProgressState; never read by node generation.
systems.targetResponsibility: Either consume in procedural schedule or remove writer.
systems.rationale: Dead write misleads future Sanctuary guarantee work.
systems.shutdownOrMergePlan: Disable writer until consumer exists, or wire into schedule.
systems.migrationRequirement: None.

systems.component: Normal Sanctuary generation and twisted variants
systems.currentBehavior: rollSanctuarySchedule always places local 14 + extras; sectorGraph injects SANCTUARY nodes. Twisted CORRUPTED_SANCTUARY (D2) and NO_EXIT_SANCTUARY (D3) lock ATTUNE+GRAFT until choice resolves. No ALTERED_SANCTUARY id.
systems.targetResponsibility: Guarantee ≥1 reachable normal Sanctuary per depth; keep twisted as exceptional content.
systems.rationale: Core Loop §10.2 keeps Sanctuary presence; twisted variants remain valid fiction.
systems.shutdownOrMergePlan: Add per-depth guarantee if missing; leave twisted UI.
systems.migrationRequirement: None.
unresolvedQuestions: Does schedule already guarantee one per depth in all procedural paths?

systems.component: Catalog definitions (TRINKET_POOL / POST_COMBAT_BOON_POOL)
systems.currentBehavior: Six mid-run combat Trinket defs in TRINKET_POOL and five POST_COMBAT_BOON_POOL variants grant parry/slice/abyssal/HP/stamina bonuses. Distinct from Expedition Relics (KeepsakeId) and Run Items.
systems.targetResponsibility: None — Core Loop §4.3 removes legacy mid-run combat trinkets without converting them into boons.
systems.rationale: Superseded catalogs with no live product ownership; post-combat pool is unused.

evidence.note: Legacy post-combat trinket variants (not class boons)

systems.shutdownOrMergePlan: Delete pools and Trinket interface after grant/runtime callers removed; do not touch keepsake/run-item registries.
systems.migrationRequirement: None for PlayerAccount; activeTrinkets is session RunState only.
unresolvedQuestions: Should CRITICAL_SUCCESS skill-check rewards migrate to Run Items/cargo instead of pure deletion?

systems.component: Grant and acquisition paths
systems.currentBehavior: applyTrinket exists but no screen calls it. Skill-check CRITICAL_SUCCESS appends one TRINKET_POOL entry via applySkillCheckTier. pickRandomPostCombatBoons has zero call sites. Live PostCombatBoonScreen awards class boons, not Trinket. startSkillCheck has no call sites found.
systems.targetResponsibility: All grant paths unreachable; no replacement mid-run combat-trinket grants.
systems.rationale: Core Loop requires every reward-pool route that can still grant combat trinkets disabled before deletion.

evidence.note: Exported grant API with no screen callers

systems.shutdownOrMergePlan: Feature-flag or delete skill-check trinket roll; delete applyTrinket export; leave class-boon post-combat intact.
systems.migrationRequirement: None.
unresolvedQuestions: Is SkillCheckScreen reachable via any navigator not found by symbol search?

systems.component: Runtime modifiers and combat hooks
systems.currentBehavior: aggregateModifiers sums parry/slice/abyssal into RunState. CombatScreen passes startingAbyssalReservePercent/parryWindowBonus/sliceDamagePenalty into TacticalCombatHub. parryMultiplierBonus prop is unused in hub body.
systems.targetResponsibility: Zero combat influence from activeTrinkets.
systems.rationale: Runtime path only populated by near-dead grants; must have no live influence.
systems.shutdownOrMergePlan: Remove aggregation; keep hub props only if another non-trinket source needs them.
systems.migrationRequirement: None.
unresolvedQuestions: Is parryMultiplierBonus awaiting a non-trinket source?

systems.component: Save fields, UI, debrief, telemetry
systems.currentBehavior: activeTrinkets on session RunState only. Hub equipment.trinketId always null. RunCompleteScreen shows TRINKETS count. No OperationDebrief keepsake-style reporting. Telemetry tracks keepsake/runItem triggers, not combat trinkets. trinketBalanceConfig validates expedition relic soft-caps (naming collision).
systems.targetResponsibility: No presentation or persistence of mid-run combat trinkets.
systems.rationale: Presentation of a retired system; rename relic balance config separately.
systems.shutdownOrMergePlan: Drop activeTrinkets and trinketId; rename trinketBalanceConfig later; leave keepsake debrief alone.
systems.migrationRequirement: Ignore/strip trinketId on load if present.

systems.component: Horizontal weapon-family unlock and equip
systems.currentBehavior: Nine families, three per class; weaponUnlocks, equippedWeaponByClass, WEAPON_REGISTRY identity/WA kits. Unlock spend is permanent horizontal access.
systems.targetResponsibility: Preserve family ownership and kit identity; no vertical combat power.
systems.rationale: Core Loop §4.1 keeps nine families; §4.2 converts progression to horizontal unlocks only.
systems.shutdownOrMergePlan: N/A — retain while stripping tiers.
systems.migrationRequirement: None.

systems.component: Vertical Tier I–III combat-stat ladder and T3 once-per-combat passives
systems.currentBehavior: Every family has tiers [1,2,3] with escalating statModifiers and often T3 oncePerCombatPassive. resolveWeaponState(family,tier) feeds combat damage/cost/resource/pierce. Descent snapshots activeWeaponTier.
systems.targetResponsibility: Single power row per family (baseline stats); retire vertical ladder and tier-only passives.
systems.rationale: Core Loop §4.3 disables permanent Tier I→III combat-stat growth and Tier III combat passives.
systems.shutdownOrMergePlan: Flatten registry to one combat row; always resolveWeaponState(id,1) or equivalent; decide which T3 fantasies become permanent family traits.
systems.migrationRequirement: Clamp saved weaponTiers[*]→1 or delete map; activeWeaponTier always 1.
unresolvedQuestions: Baseline = T1 stats, or fold selected T3 fantasies into family identity?

systems.component: Tier upgrade economy, UI, debrief, debug
systems.currentBehavior: canUpgradeWeaponTier/upgradeWeaponTier spend stash; ChassisWorkspace/WeaponLoadoutPanel upgrade UI; debrief UPGRADE_AVAILABLE; god mode unlockAllWeapons sets tiers to 3.
systems.targetResponsibility: No vertical upgrade spend; keep family unlock spend.
systems.rationale: Vertical economy is the treadmill Core Loop removes.
systems.shutdownOrMergePlan: Remove upgrade buttons/costs/debrief lines; keep unlock+equip.
systems.migrationRequirement: Normalize weaponTiers away; compensation policy for prior spends UNKNOWN.
unresolvedQuestions: Refund stash for prior tier upgrades?
